expectations.buyer: Households, appliance repairers, makers, print shops, and parts retailers
expectations.pain: A missing or broken low-risk appliance knob is unavailable or does not fit its shaft and orientation
expectations.strongestIncumbent: OEM spares, generic knobs, marketplaces, model libraries, calipers, CAD, and local print services
expectations.biggestRisk: Heat, electrical, gas, load, labeling, and control ambiguity create safety exclusions; commodity replacements may be cheaper
